lore.embers_and_icicles.brittle_ice: Thin, fragile ice that forms when water freezes next to Blue Ice, and covers crevasses in Ice Caves. It cracks under anything walking on it, and soon gives way.
lore.embers_and_icicles.ice_crystal: A glowing ice crystal that grows in Ice Caves. Gives off a faint light.
lore.embers_and_icicles.icicle: A sharp spike of ice. Ice Spikes grow longer in the dark and melt near light. Hanging ones fall on whoever walks below, and landing on a pointed one hurts.
entity.embers_and_icicles.frostbite.desc: An undead hostile mob found in snowy biomes and Ice Caves whose attacks inflict Freezing. Some throw Ice Cubes. Zombies left standing in Powder Snow turn into Frostbites.
effect.embers_and_icicles.freezing.descr: Freezes you over time as if stuck in Powder Snow. Once fully frozen, you move slower and take damage. Inflicted by Frostbites and thrown Ice Cubes.
effect.embers_and_icicles.burning.descri: Burns you until it runs out or is put out with water.
